en.headline: Unconscious climber airlifted after Kowloon Peak fall
en.dek: Firefighters found the man in heavy rain on Friday evening and flew him to Eastern Hospital; his companion was also injured.
body: Firefighters rescued a man who fell while rock climbing at Kowloon Peak on Friday afternoon and flew him to Eastern Hospital, where he was unconscious, local media reported. His companion was also injured and taken to the same hospital.

Police received a report at about 2:30pm that two men were climbing at the spot known as Suicide Cliff and that one had fallen. Firefighters searched on foot in heavy rain and abseiled to the man. A Government Flying Service helicopter joined the search. Reports said rescuers located him at about 4pm and brought him up at about 6pm before he was winched to Eastern Hospital.

Hong Kong 01 reported that the man was unconscious when found and that mechanical chest compressions were used after he arrived at hospital. His companion was conscious but injured and was also flown to Eastern Hospital. Oriental Daily News reported that both men were off-duty ambulance officers who had gone climbing together. The Fire Services Department had not publicly confirmed their jobs or the severity of the injuries by Friday evening.

The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department lists Suicide Cliff as a hazardous location in the country parks, where fatal and serious incidents have occurred before. Friday's fall came during the showers and thunderstorms that affected the eastern New Territories through the afternoon.

zh.headline: 飛鵝山攀石男子昏迷　直升機送東區醫院
zh.dek: 消防員星期五傍晚在大雨中尋獲墮崖男子，他送院時昏迷，同行男子亦受傷。
body: 一名男子星期五下午在飛鵝山攀石時墮下，消防員在傍晚將他救起，由政府飛行服務隊直升機送往東區醫院。本地媒體報道，他獲救時昏迷；同行男子亦受傷，同樣送往東區醫院。
警方約下午2時半接報，指兩名男子在俗稱自殺崖的位置攀石，其中一人墮下。消防員冒雨徒步搜索並游繩前往，政府飛行服務隊直升機在上空協助。報道指，救援人員約下午4時鎖定位置，約下午6時將事主救回山上，再吊送東區醫院。
《香港01》報道，事主尋獲時已昏迷，抵院後要用自動心外壓機急救；同行男子仍然清醒，但亦受傷，同樣由直升機送東區醫院。《東方日報》報道，兩人同為休班救護員，當日結伴攀石。截至星期五晚上，消防處未有公開確認兩人職業或傷勢。
漁農自然護理署把自殺崖列為郊野公園內的危險地點，該處過往曾發生致命及嚴重意外。事發時新界東正受驟雨及雷暴影響。
